description: SEC 10-K MD&A Analyzer — Pull Item 7 Management's Discussion and Analysis (MD&A) from a company's latest (or earlier, filing=0-4) Form 10-K on SEC EDGAR: ticker= or cik=. Returns filing metadata and URL, section size, sub-headings, theme mentions (tariffs, inflation, interest rates, AI, restructuring, FX, China...), and an AI analyst summary: key drivers with direction, segments, liquidity, capital allocation, outlook, highlighted risks, tone (CONFIDENT/NEUTRAL/CAUTIOUS/DEFENSIVE) and notable numbers checked verbatim against the filing. summary=0 skips the AI part. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_mdna
